artifact_note: Campaign plan_v2 was rebuilt during review. Frozen input pins identify the checked generation; prior results.json recorded the earlier generation.

success_hosts.sql:
SELECT regexp_extract(requested_url,'^https?://([^/]+)',1) host,count(*) capture_rows,count(DISTINCT requested_url) urls FROM c
 WHERE ends_with(requested_url,'&download=1') AND http_status=200 AND is_real_file GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY host

house_attempts.sql:
SELECT http_status,outcome,record_role,count(*) capture_rows,count(DISTINCT requested_url) urls FROM c
 WHERE regexp_matches(requested_url,'^https?://[^/]*[.]house[.]gov/') AND ends_with(requested_url,'&download=1') AND http_status IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ALL

amp_transitions.sql:
SELECT a.disposition previous_disposition,b.disposition current_disposition,b.subtype,count(*) urls FROM d0 a JOIN d b USING(target_url)
 WHERE ends_with(a.target_url,'&download=1') GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

pending_chambers.sql:
SELECT CASE WHEN regexp_matches(target_url,'^https?://[^/]*[.]house[.]gov/') THEN 'House' ELSE 'other' END chamber,count(*) urls
 FROM d WHERE disposition='needs_acquisition' AND ends_with(target_url,'&download=1') GROUP BY ALL

selected_repairs.sql: SELECT candidate_source,count(*) AS n,count(DISTINCT target_url) targets FROM selected WHERE candidate_source='repaired_download_query' GROUP BY ALL

senate_state.sql: SELECT capture_disposition,capture_reason,count(*) AS n FROM st WHERE contains(requested_url,'/404?notfound=') GROUP BY ALL

table_counts.sql: SELECT 'publisher_links' table_name,count(*) AS n FROM p UNION ALL SELECT 'plan',count(*) FROM d0 UNION ALL SELECT 'plan_v2',count(*) FROM d UNION ALL SELECT 'sources',count(*) FROM s

spaces.sql: SELECT 'plan' AS generation_name,count(*) urls FROM d0 WHERE ends_with(target_url,'%20') UNION ALL SELECT 'plan_v2',count(*) FROM d WHERE ends_with(target_url,'%20')

source_hex.sql:
SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE regexp_matches(url,'%[0-9A-F][A-F]')) defense_upper_regex,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE regexp_matches(url,'%([0-9A-Fa-f][A-F]|[A-F][0-9A-Fa-f])')) either_upper_digit,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE regexp_matches(url,'%([0-9A-Fa-f][a-f]|[a-f][0-9A-Fa-f])')) either_lower_digit FROM s

pending_repaired_already_attempted.sql:
WITH pending AS (SELECT target_url,regexp_replace(target_url,'(?:%20|\s)*&download=1$','?download=1') repaired FROM d
 WHERE disposition='needs_acquisition' AND ends_with(target_url,'&download=1') AND regexp_matches(target_url,'^https?://[^/]*[.]house[.]gov/'))
 SELECT w.http_status,w.outcome,w.qualification_status,count(DISTINCT p.target_url) targets FROM pending p JOIN wave w ON p.repaired=w.candidate_url GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

pending_repaired_examples.sql:
WITH pending AS (SELECT target_url,regexp_replace(target_url,'(?:%20|\s)*&download=1$','?download=1') repaired FROM d
 WHERE disposition='needs_acquisition' AND ends_with(target_url,'&download=1') AND regexp_matches(target_url,'^https?://[^/]*[.]house[.]gov/'))
 SELECT p.target_url,w.candidate_url,w.http_status,w.outcome,w.qualification_status,w.receipt_key FROM pending p JOIN wave w ON p.repaired=w.candidate_url ORDER BY p.target_url LIMIT 3

wave4_pending_cohort.query:
WITH pending AS (SELECT target_url,regexp_replace(target_url,'(?:%20|\s)*&download=1$','?download=1') repaired FROM old
 WHERE disposition='needs_acquisition' AND ends_with(target_url,'&download=1') AND regexp_matches(target_url,'^https?://[^/]*[.]house[.]gov/')
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM selected s WHERE s.target_url=old.target_url AND candidate_source='repaired_download_query'))
 SELECT w.http_status,w.outcome,w.qualification_status,count(DISTINCT p.target_url) FROM pending p JOIN wave w ON p.repaired=w.candidate_url GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

trailing_space_corpus_validation.campaign_proposed_key: regexp_replace(split_part(url_key,'?',1),'(?:%20|/)+$','') || CASE WHEN contains(url_key,'?') THEN substring(url_key,strpos(url_key,'?')) ELSE '' END
trailing_space_corpus_validation.campaign_join: Join each proposed key to keyed_universe.url_key; retain existing literal target URLs.
trailing_space_corpus_validation.source_screen: Select every distinct source URL containing %20, whitespace, repeated slashes (regex [^:]//), or matching any wrapper pattern from model/registries/url-rules.json. Separately confirmed zero source URLs containing backslashes.
trailing_space_corpus_validation.native_method: Run model/sql/url-normalized.sql unchanged and with regexp_replace(c.path,'/$','') replaced by regexp_replace(c.path,'(?:%20|/)+$',''). Use current url-rules.json and empty url_variants. Compare base_key for each literal URL. All 27 historical affected keys equal current native results; each proposed result equals the current native key of its clean spelling.
trailing_space_corpus_validation.capture_method: Read matching basename candidates from requested_url, url, source_url, original_url, recovered_url; then match affected literal URLs exactly for the per-address summaries. Candidate basename matches on other hosts are not counted as counterpart evidence.
trailing_space_corpus_validation.conclusion: No demonstrated distinct-document collision in the checked corpus. The only existing clean campaign counterpart is a published PDF paired with an encoded-space 404 response. No published-source normalization keys change. Withdraw the corpus document-loss objection; future URL equivalence and successful recovery of all 27 addresses are not established.
trailing_space_corpus_validation.limits: Read-only retained-artifact and native normalization check; no live fetch, acquisition, publication rebuild, or document regrouping was performed.
